name: TNT Minecraft
description: 9 TNT -> 1 compressed TNT, 10 tiers, each 9x the destroyed volume of the last (radius 8/17/36/75/128). Fuse timer for EVERY TNT (even vanilla): hold right-click 1 s, then /tntfuse <seconds>. Dirt/Stone/Crop TNT: 4 material + 4 gunpowder, clears its material in a 10x10x10 area with zero damage and drops the items. English + Persian.
